payload.reason: The evidence provides specific criteria for selecting the four conversational QA models based on their architectures and training strategies, as well as their performance in human evaluations.

claims.text: The four conversational QA models were selected based on their different architectures and training strategies: BERT, GraphFlow, HAM, and ExCorD.
BERT serves as a baseline model that concatenates previous turns, while GraphFlow uses a recurrent graph neural network to model dependencies.
HAM employs a history attention mechanism to select relevant previous turns, and ExCorD generates context-independent questions for training.
